The '''Enrichment Dome''' was a [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] facility located in the [[Eastern Enrichment Zone]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. As Bandomeer's natural conditions could not sustain the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] that were grown in the facility for research, its interior was lit by an artificial [[Star/Legends|sun]], with AgriCorps staff being forbidden to be inside the dome at [[Local day/Legends|night]]. Hidden inside the dome's wall was an [[Dome wall secret annex|annex]] in which the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] stored [[Mining/Legends|mining]] supplies.<ref name="TDR" />

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'' is set in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> failed [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to the Enrichment Dome to learn about the AgriCorps' work by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. At the facility, Kenobi was met by the [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Si Treemba]] and the [[Meerian/Legends|Meerian]] [[RonTha]] for a tour of the dome. During the tour, RonTha was called back to the [[Main administration building|administration building]], and while he was gone, Kenobi and Treemba discovered the hidden annex. Jinn later came to the dome himself to arrange for transportation to the [[deepsea mines]] located on the [[Great Sea of Bandomeer]].<ref name="TDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Enrichment Dome was featured in the young adult novel ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'', the second book in the [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|''Jedi Apprentice'']] series. The novel was written by [[Jude Watson]] and published in [[1999]].<ref name="TDR" />
